page0.text:
How should I spend those remaining hours?
I thought a lot about it, but wound up here in the end.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-05:page0:1

page1.text: "This place...always remains the same. I enjoy the peace of the living room, but I am more comfortable here."
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-05:page1:1

page2.text: "Yeah. For a Western knight, you look so natural with a bamboo sword. Plus, you like sitting seiza. We should've put on some kendo gear and had a match while we had the chance."
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-05:page2:1

page3.text:
"Wear protective gear? Why did you not say so earlier? I would have worn my armor while you put on protective gear for a mock match.
...Yes, we really should have done that.
If only you had mentioned it earlier, I could have gone all out in a match with you, Shirou."
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-05:page3:1

page4.text:
"Ack..."
Saber's so cute when she pouts like that.
Cute as she is, her actual words are pretty terrifying.
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-05:page4:1

page5.text: "You're not really serious about going all out, are you? If you fought me without holding back, I'd wind up bedridden for a week."
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-05:page5:1

page6.text:
"No, that is not true.
You underestimate yourself. You really have grown as a swordsman these past few days. At this point, you may even be able to land a hit on me."
"Eh? Really?"
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-05:page6:1

page7.text:
Even if she's only flattering me, I'm delighted.
How could I not respect Saber when it comes to swordsmanship?
Being able to land a hit on my mentor is like proof of my growing skill.
page7.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-05:page7:1

page8.text:
"For real? So...you're saying that if the conditions and timing were right, I might actually be able to land a hit on you?"
"That is correct. You have grown strong, Shirou. You should be proud of that. I am very pleased."
page8.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-05:page8:1

page9.text:
...
I can tell she's being honest as she smiles at me.
When I see her face like that, my determination starts to waver.
Afterwards...
We won't be able to come back. If only we could just run away instead of facing a battle we have such a slim chance of actually winning.
page9.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-05:page9:1

page10.text:
"Shirou? Why have you gone quiet?
Are your wounds still hurting you? If so, you must rest in your room..."
"No, I'm fine. Nothing's hurting."
page10.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-05:page10:1

page11.text:
I push my hesitation aside.
I can't run away, and this isn't how I want to spend my final moments with Saber.
page11.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-05:page11:1

page12.text:
"Hey Saber. Since we're here, want to have a quick spar? Not a serious bout, just a fun, lighthearted match."
I bury my feelings and try to put on as strong a face as I can.
page12.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-05:page12:1

page13.text:
"Very well.
Then I will fight in my own style, rather than kendo. Shirou, you can fight me in whatever style you want as well."
page13.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-05:page13:1

page14.text:
She must have understood what I had in mind.
Trading blows with a sword rather than words suits us better.
page14.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-05:page14:1
